module_summary: 64-bit UDP block: an RX instance strips UDP headers from incoming IP frames, while the TX path chains a checksum generator (payload/header FIFOs) into a UDP-to-IP framer, all with header and payload AXI-Stream handshakes.

groups.name: UDP receive
groups.description: udp_ip_rx_64 parses UDP header from IP payload and outputs UDP header plus payload.

groups.name: UDP checksum generator
groups.description: udp_checksum_gen_64 computes length and checksum, buffering payload and headers in FIFOs.

groups.name: UDP transmit framer
groups.description: udp_ip_tx_64 prepends the UDP header word and emits an IP frame with protocol 0x11.
